items.title: 7.3.1 Causes of the Digital Divide (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of causes of the digital divide (PDF 182-183).

blocks.text: Digital divide ki kai wajoohat (factors) hain:

items: Economic Barriers (maali rukawatein): Digital divide ki ek bari wajah paise ki kami hai. Bohat se log aur khandan computer, smartphone ya broadband internet ka kharcha bardasht nahi kar sakte. Yeh maali farq khaas taur par developing countries (taraqqi pazeer mulkon), dehi (rural) ilaqon aur kam aamdani wale logon mein nazar aata hai.

Geographical Barriers (jughrafiyai yaani jagah ki rukawatein): Shehri (urban) aur dehi (rural) ilaqon mein ICT tak rasai mein bara farq hai. Duniya ke kai hisson mein, khaas taur par door daraz ya dehi ilaqon mein, internet ke liye zaroori infrastructure (bunyadi dhancha, jaise towers aur cables) ya to kamzor hai ya hai hi nahi.

Educational Barriers (taleemi rukawatein): Digital literacy ki kami bhi digital divide ki ek bari wajah hai. Technology maujood ho tab bhi log sahi taleem aur training na hone ki wajah se use achhi tarah istemal karna nahi jante.

Social Barriers (samaji rukawatein): Umar, gender (mard ya aurat hona) aur disability (maazoori) bhi technology tak rasai par asar dalti hain. Maslan buzurg log nayi technology istemal karne mein kam dilchaspi rakhte ya kam qabil hote hain, aur kuch ilaqon mein khawateen ko cultural (saqafati, riwayati) rukawaton ki wajah se ICT tak kam rasai milti hai.

blocks.prompt: Hukumat har student ko muft laptop de de. Digital divide ki kaunsi wajah door hogi aur kaunsi baqi rahegi?
blocks.explanation: Device khareedne ki economic barrier door hogi. Lekin agar ilaqe mein internet nahi (geographical barrier) ya student ko istemal karna nahi aata (educational barrier), to yeh rukawatein baqi rahengi.

items: Chaar wajoohat: economic (kharcha), geographical (dehi ilaqon mein infrastructure nahi), educational (digital literacy ki kami), social (umar, gender, disability).
